title: Enriched extension from adjunction data to the walking coherent adjunction
statement:
Use quasicategories and coherent transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], adjunction units, counits and triangle witnesses of [def-coef-coherent-adjunction-data], the ordinal conventions of [def-coef-coherent-monad-modules], and compatible enriched simplicial presentations of [lem-coef-enriched-simplicial-presentation]. A locally quasicategorical simplicial category $\mathscr K$ is a simplicial category with every hom-simplicial set a quasicategory. Its homotopy $2$-category has these same objects and hom-categories the homotopy categories of those quasicategories.

Let $L:c\to d$ and $U:d\to c$ be arrows of $\mathscr K$, with unit $\eta:1_c\to UL$, counit $\epsilon:LU\to1_d$ and triangle witnesses presenting an adjunction in its homotopy $2$-category. Let $\mathsf{Adj}$ be the simplicial category obtained by taking the nerve of each hom-category of the free $2$-category on an adjunction $\ell\dashv u$; its endomorphism at the source of $\ell$ is $D=N(\Delta_+)$, and its hom from the target of $\ell$ to that source is $W=N(\Delta_\infty)$, with the left $D$-action by composition. There exists a simplicial functor $H:\mathsf{Adj}\to\mathscr K$ taking $\ell,u,\eta,\epsilon$ to $L,U,\eta,\epsilon$. One chosen triangle witness can also be fixed; no assertion is made that both prescribed witnesses are fixed simultaneously.

Restriction of $H$ gives a strict simplicial walking-monad diagram with endofunctor $UL$, unit $\eta$ and multiplication $U\epsilon L$, and a strictly $D$-equivariant map
$$W\longrightarrow\mathscr K(d,c).$$
The latter has singleton value $U$ and action transformation $U\epsilon:ULU\to U$; all its higher action simplices are restrictions of $H$. When $\mathscr K$ is a compatible enriched presentation, these are enriched transformations and their entire higher simplices. When the adjunction arrows and transformations preserve tensors by specified coherent comparisons, choose the presentation retaining that data: the extension retains it as well. Thus evaluating the displayed equivariant map on objects of $E_d$ gives the coherent action of $UL$ on $UY$ and does so in the full enriched functor category, before taking any homotopy category.
